_comment: The feature register: one row per standard or feature a repo must have on. `olivercode features --repo NAME` prints each row on or off with its enable command, and `olivercode conform` fails a repo for every off row whose owner_only is false. check names the command a person runs to see the state, enable is the command that turns it on ({repo} is the repo's folder), id selects the test in scripts/lib/features.py, machine is each for a feature every machine on the repo must have, or single with a single_reason for an owner view that one machine keeps (`olivercode machines` and `conform` compare every machine that recorded itself), and freshness is last-run for a scheduled job (on only while its last run exited 0 and is newer than twice its interval) or exists for a row that is on when its file or setting is there. covers lists the launcher commands and launchd labels a row accounts for, and utilities lists the commands that are tools and not features; a test fails when a command, a job label or a --schedule command in OliverCode appears in neither, so every new part gets a row first.

features.title: Board baseline
features.explain: The standard set of columns and fields on the repo's GitHub Project board, found on the repo's Projects tab on GitHub and set up with `olivercode backlog-setup REPO --apply`.

features.title: Story template
features.explain: The fixed shape every story takes (an owner line, a scenario, an epic and a priority), kept in skills/backlog/references/story-template.md and checked when a story is filed.

features.title: Area label
features.explain: A label on each story that names the part of the repo it touches, shown on the GitHub issue and added by `olivercode backlog-setup REPO --apply`.

features.title: Commit gates
features.explain: The commit gates that block secrets, personal data and oversize changes, installed in the repo's git hooks and checked with `olivercode conform REPO --hooks-only`.

features.title: Permission policy
features.explain: A list in the repo's .olivercode/policy.json of what a session may do without asking you, created with `olivercode policy init REPO`.

features.title: Owner queue
features.explain: One list of the steps only you can take, kept in ~/.olivercode/owner-queue.jsonl and read with `olivercode owner list`.
features.single_reason: the owner reads one queue, so one machine keeps it

features.title: Burndown
features.explain: A count of open issues per repo taken every 15 minutes by a launchd job on this machine, logged in ~/.olivercode/burndown.log and read with `olivercode board burndown`.
features.single_reason: the owner reads one burndown, so one machine runs the job

features.title: Decision records
features.enable: olivercode decisions record --decision TEXT --thread ID --words TEXT --choice TEXT --by NAME
features.explain: The exact words you used for each decision, kept in ~/.olivercode/relays.jsonl, read with `olivercode decisions show` and filled from an old log with `olivercode decisions import FILE`.

features.title: Lessons and retro
features.explain: A weekly review that adds a candidate for each lesson with no check, with its date kept in ~/.olivercode/retro.json and read with `olivercode retro`.

features.title: Nightly sweep
features.explain: A nightly check at 02:30 that finds board cards out of step with their issues and writes one line per board to your owner queue, run by a launchd job on this machine and read with `olivercode board sweep`.

features.title: Groom schedule
features.explain: A pass that fills in Priority and Size on stories and moves ready ones forward, started by the daily maintenance job on this machine and read with `olivercode board groom`.

features.title: Daily maintenance job
features.explain: A daily upkeep job that repairs what is safe to repair, such as broken links, merged branches and empty worktrees, run by a launchd job on this machine and read with `olivercode maintain`.

features.title: Headless builders
features.explain: Each story builds in one fresh headless Claude session that `olivercode dispatch N` or `olivercode drain REPO` starts, with no window to click; the runner validates and lands the commit.

features.title: Worktree cleanup
features.explain: A daily clean-up of finished worktrees and branches under _worktrees, run by a launchd job on this machine and started by hand with `olivercode clean`.

features.title: Unfinished-work snapshot
features.explain: A saved list of work not yet landed, kept in ~/.olivercode/ and shown with `olivercode wip list`.

features.title: Gap sweep
features.explain: A nightly job that files one story per standard a repo has off, run by a launchd job on this machine and read with `olivercode gap-sweep`.

features.title: Fleet sync
features.explain: A nightly job at 03:30 that brings each clean fleet repo level with GitHub, run by a launchd job on this machine and read with `olivercode fleet-sync`.

features.title: Recurring review
features.explain: A recurring job that runs the conform, board sync, update-check and update steps your fleet repo's review-config.json switches on, run by a launchd job and read with `olivercode review`.

features.title: GitHub write replay
features.explain: A job every ten minutes that sends GitHub writes queued during a rate limit once it resets, run by a launchd job on this machine and read with `olivercode gh-limit report`.

features.title: Version cut
features.explain: A daily job that picks the version from the day's commits and writes the changelog section, run by a launchd job on this machine and started by hand with `olivercode version-cut`.

features.title: Board sweep
features.explain: A job every thirty minutes that moves the card of each closed issue to Complete and adds each open issue that has no card, run by a launchd job on this machine and read with `olivercode board sync --dry-run`.
